app.title: Thaumic Cast
speakers.none: The network was asked for Sonos speakers and returned none.
speakers.scan_hint: Check they are switched on and on this network, then ask again.
speakers.manual_add_hint: If asking gets nowhere, a speaker can be <0>added by its IP address</0>.
server.restart_description: Closes Thaumic Cast and opens it again, which ends every cast on the way.
server.disconnect_description: Hangs up on every extension, which ends every cast. The extensions ring back by themselves in a few seconds; the casts need starting again.
server.stop_streams_description: Stops every cast, including any started from another computer, whose owner has not been consulted.
settings.autostart_description: Have Thaumic Cast ready and waiting when you arrive
settings.speaker_monitor_description: Works out every few seconds, from each speaker's playback position, how much audio it has in hand. This is what warns you before a speaker runs out, and what drift correction steers by. Turning it off also turns off speaker notices. Takes effect from each speaker's next connection.
settings.speaker_monitor_env_on: THAUMIC_SPEAKER_MONITOR has insisted on this being on, and it outranks the checkbox.
settings.speaker_monitor_env_off: THAUMIC_SPEAKER_MONITOR has insisted on this being off, and it outranks the checkbox.
settings.head_start_description: Audio sent to each speaker as fast as it will take it when it starts playing, so it can ride out Wi-Fi hiccups. It adds the same delay, which video sync allows for. 500 ms suits most homes; raise it if one speaker on a weak Wi-Fi link cuts out. Applies from each speaker's next connection. PCM casts only.
settings.head_start_env: THAUMIC_PCM_CONNECT_BURST_MS has insisted on {{value}} ms, and it outranks the setting.
settings.head_start_env_off: THAUMIC_PCM_CONNECT_BURST_MS has insisted on the head start being off, and it outranks the setting.
settings.drift_description: No two clocks agree exactly, so over a long cast a speaker slowly uses up its head start. Correction stretches or squeezes the audio by a tiny amount, at most 150 parts per million and far too little to hear, to keep each speaker's supply level. PCM casts only.
settings.drift_needs_monitor: Needs Keep an eye on speakers.
settings.drift_env: THAUMIC_DRIFT_COMPENSATION has insisted on {{label}}, and it outranks the setting.
settings.manual_speakers_empty: No speakers have been added by hand
settings.check_for_updates_description: Opens the releases page in your browser
dashboard.speaker_notice_head_start_ran_: {{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms, and a {{current}} ms head start lasts {{current}} ms. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
{{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms, and what was left of its {{current}} ms head start did not stretch to it. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
{{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms and the speaker head start is off, so nothing had been put by for it. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
dashboard.speaker_notice_head_start_clos: {{name}} very nearly cut out: a {{stall}} ms Wi-Fi stall left it {{left}} ms of its {{current}} ms head start, which is not a margin. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
{{name}} very nearly cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms with the speaker head start off, and it got through on what it happened to have. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
dashboard.speaker_notice_head_start_no_r: {{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms, which is more than the longest head start can cover, and that makes it a matter of furniture. Move the speaker nearer the router, or give it an Ethernet cable.
dashboard.speaker_notice_where: The speaker head start is under Settings > Speakers, and a new value takes effect when the speaker next connects, such as when a cast restarts.
dashboard.speaker_notice_where_fixed: THAUMIC_PCM_CONNECT_BURST_MS fixes the speaker head start, and the setting gives way to it; change the variable.
dashboard.speaker_notice_running_low: {{name}} has about {{left}} ms left in reserve, and when that goes, so does the sound.
dashboard.speaker_notice_running_low_dri: The clock in {{name}} runs a little fast, and that is where the reserve has been going.
dashboard.speaker_notice_drift_uncorrect: The clock in {{name}} runs a little fast, so it gets through audio quicker than audio arrives, and will run low in about {{minutes}} min.
dashboard.speaker_notice_drift_saturated: The clock in {{name}} is further out than clock drift correction is permitted to correct, so it will run low in about {{minutes}} min.
dashboard.speaker_notice_drift_turn_on_d: Turn on clock drift correction under Settings > Speakers; it starts work when the speaker next connects.
dashboard.speaker_notice_restart_refills: Stop the cast and start it again; that refills the reserve.
network.speakers_not_responding: The speakers were found, but nothing is getting back from them. That is nearly always a VPN or a firewall: pause it, then ask again.
network.speakers_unreachable: No speaker can be reached on this network. Firewalls and VPNs make a habit of this; pause yours.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Thaumic Cast
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: The half that talks to the speakers
onboarding.welcome.body_windows: This app finds your Sonos speakers and serves them the audio your browser sends.* It lives in the system tray and does not need looking at.
onboarding.welcome.body_macos: This app finds your Sonos speakers and serves them the audio your browser sends.* It lives in the menu bar and does not need looking at.
onboarding.welcome.body_linux: This app finds your Sonos speakers and serves them the audio your browser sends.* It lives in the system tray and does not need looking at.
onboarding.welcome.footnote: * Think of it as a very dedicated postal service for sound.
onboarding.firewall.title: A brief interruption
onboarding.firewall.prompt_windows: Windows is about to ask whether this app may use the network. Say yes: the speakers come to this computer to fetch the audio, and a firewall that turns them away gets you silence.
onboarding.firewall.prompt_macos: macOS, or a firewall such as Little Snitch, may ask about addresses beginning 224. That is multicast, which is how one asks a whole network a question without knowing anybody's name. Allow it.
onboarding.firewall.prompt_linux: If this computer runs a firewall, it needs to allow incoming connections on ports 49400-49410. Nobody will ask; a Linux firewall expects you to know.
onboarding.firewall.reason_1: The extension sends the audio to this app.
onboarding.firewall.reason_2: This app tells the speakers where to fetch it, and they do.
onboarding.firewall.reason_3: All of it stays on your own network. None of it has business elsewhere.
onboarding.speakers.title: Finding the speakers
onboarding.speakers.subtitle: Asking the network who is in
onboarding.speakers.none_found_hint: Check each one is switched on, and on the same network as this computer, then ask again.
onboarding.speakers.manual_hint: For networks that do not pass the question on
onboarding.speakers.manual_error_unreach: Nothing answered at that address. Check the speaker is switched on, and that the address is its own.
onboarding.speakers.manual_error_not_son: Something answered at that address, and it was not a Sonos speaker. Check the address.
onboarding.speakers.manual_error_invalid: That is not an address a Sonos speaker can have. Theirs look like 192.168.1.100.
onboarding.speakers.manual_error_generic: The speaker could not be added, and the reason did not make it this far. Check the address, then try again.
onboarding.extension.title: The extension
onboarding.extension.subtitle: The half that lives in Chrome
onboarding.extension.body: Install the Thaumic Cast extension in Chrome. It is where you choose a tab and press Cast; without it this app has speakers and nothing to tell them.
onboarding.extension.checking: Waiting to hear from the extension…
onboarding.extension.skip_hint: It can be installed later. This app will wait; it has nothing else on.
onboarding.ready.title: Ready to cast
onboarding.ready.subtitle: The rest happens in the browser
onboarding.ready.intro: Up to {{maxStreams}} browser tabs can be cast at once. The number was chosen, not discovered.
onboarding.ready.performance_body: This is best for music. The speakers play a little behind the browser, which does a song no harm and makes a film look badly dubbed. Video sync, in the extension, puts that right.
onboarding.ready.battery_warning: A laptop on battery will economise, and the browser is among the first things it economises on. If the audio cuts out, plug it in.
onboarding.ready.autostart_description: Starts Thaumic Cast when you log in, so it is running before you remember you wanted it.
